thread:
tara: hitting 401 on hosted API from our Electron app, even though the header looks right when I log it locally. anyone seen weird invisible chars in API keys?
ashwin: can you paste how you build the Authorization header?
tara: sure — in node: `const auth = Buffer.from(`${process.env.RD_API_KEY}:`).toString('base64')` then `Authorization: `Basic ${auth}`. prints fine in console but server rejects it.
mia: quick check — print the raw bytes/hex of the env var. sometimes copy/paste from docs or spreadsheets adds hidden chars (BOM, NBSP, CRLF). e.g. `printf '%s' "$RD_API_KEY" | xxd -p` or `printf '%s' "$RD_API_KEY" | od -An -tx1`.
tara: ran `printf '%s' "$RD_API_KEY" | od -An -tx1` and got `ef bb bf 61 62 63 ...` — so it's a BOM (`0xEF 0xBB 0xBF`) at the start. no wonder base64 doesn't match server-side key. thanks.
samir: ugh, that pops up when people copy keys from some Windows editors or export via excel. two quick fixes: strip BOM before encoding, or sanitize on load. on unix: `export RD_API_KEY=$(printf "%s" "$RD_API_KEY" | sed '1s/^\xEF\xBB\xBF//')`.
nashwin: for a cross-platform CLI-friendly variant: `python - <<'PY'
import sys
print(sys.stdin.read().lstrip('\ufeff'), end='')
PY` or `node -e "process.stdout.write(require('fs').readFileSync(0,'utf8').replace(/^\uFEFF/,''))"`.
tara: thanks — sanitized locally and requests now succeed.
mia: we should also make the SDK more defensive. small shim in client init: `const key = (process.env.RD_API_KEY || '').replace(/^\uFEFF/, '')` before forming the header. saves a lot of support tickets.
samir: +1 — i'll open a tiny PR to trim BOM and trailing whitespace before encoding and add a test. also add a note in devex: how to debug and strip hidden chars.
tara: that'd be awesome. i'll drop the reproduction steps in the PR description.
deploy-bot: lint OK on branch sanitize-bom (CI passed) :white_check_mark:
ops-bot: FYI added a short diagnostic script to /tools/dev/clean_key.sh, includes `xxd` and a python fallback.
nashwin: tiny follow-up — windows cmd users sometimes use `echo %RD_API_KEY%` which adds a newline. recommend `set /p` trick: `cmd /c "set /p=%%RD_API_KEY%% <nul"` or instructing them to use PowerShell: `[Console]::Write($Env:RD_API_KEY)` to avoid extras.
tara: good catch. will add a short section in the devex FAQ about Windows, Docker secrets, and editor BOMs.
mia: also we might catch this in onboarding: after key copy show a small sanity check that prints `echo -n $KEY | xxd -p | sed -n '1p'` and fails fast with a friendly message if BOM detected.
tara: love that UX idea. thanks all :heart:
